title: Maroon Bells Guide And Outfitters
specs: Rides offer views of Pyramid Peak, Maroon Bells, alpine meadows, wildflower fields, and wildlife including Rocky Mountain Goats and bears
Overnight trips include wilderness camping and star viewing at Willow Lake
Minimum age 7 for all rides except pony rides; younger children may ride privately at double price
Private rides available for younger children at double price
Four person minimum for dinner rides and overnight pack trips

options.name: The Proposal Ride
options.detail: Half day horseback ride to Maroon Lake with photos, chocolate dipped strawberries, and champagne for a marriage proposal

options.name: 1-Hour Ride
options.detail: Relaxing ride through Aspen grove alongside a snowmelt stream

options.name: 1 and ½ Hour Ride
options.detail: Ride through Aspen trees with views of Pyramid Peak, suitable for groups with younger children or those afraid of heights

options.name: 2-Hour Ride
options.detail: Ride along Maroon Creek through varied landscapes including hills, Aspen groves, avalanche site, and meadows

options.name: Maroon Creek Lunch Ride
options.detail: Ride through wildflower fields along Maroon Creek with a box lunch and views of the Maroon Bells

options.name: East Maroon Lunch Ride
options.detail: Ride along East Maroon Creek through alpine meadows to Wilderness base camp with lunch and possible Rocky Mountain Goat sightings

options.name: Maroon Bells Lunch Ride
options.detail: Ride through meadows and rock formations to Maroon Lake visitor center for lunch with views of the Maroon Bells

options.name: Full Day Ride
options.detail: Day ride on mountain horses in East Maroon Valley or Willow Lake Trail with lunch on the trail

options.name: Dinner Ride
options.detail: Two hour ride along Maroon Creek followed by a chef-prepared private dinner by the creek

options.name: Pony Rides
options.detail: 20-minute ride along Maroon Creek for children under age 7 led by a wrangler

options.name: Overnight Pack Trip - Base Camp
options.detail: Overnight ride to base camp with lunch, dinner, and breakfast included; activities include riding, fishing, hiking

options.name: Overnight Pack Trip - Willow Lake
options.detail: Five-day summer trip to Willow Lake with camping, meals over campfire, day rides, and hiking; for experienced riders

includes: Meals included on lunch rides and overnight trips
Chef-prepared private dinner on dinner rides
blurb: Guests can enjoy a variety of horseback rides including short relaxing rides, scenic lunch rides, full day rides, dinner rides, overnight pack trips, and specialty rides. Rides explore Aspen groves, Maroon Creek, alpine meadows, and the Maroon Bells area. Some rides include meals such as box lunches or chef-prepared dinners by the creek.
extraNote: Rides must be booked minimum 24 hours in advance; same day bookings by phone · Gratuity included in fees for online bookings · Trail fee included to help maintain trails · Maroon Bells Stables on Maroon Creek Rd at the T Lazy 7 Ranch
